subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add automatic per-DM human takeover pause behavior for manual owner replies, and should that contract be WhatsApp-only or shared across channel plugins?
rationale: The requested behavior is not implemented, existing access-control knobs do not express automatic owner takeover, and the fix would add new channel config plus runtime pause state that affects reply admission.

options.title: Design channel-owned takeover
options.body: Define a WhatsApp-first or shared channel-plugin contract for detecting manual owner messages, storing per-thread pause state, and resuming safely with docs and tests.

options.title: Limit to existing controls
options.body: Document manual approaches such as `dmPolicy`, `allowFrom`, and per-chat configuration without adding automatic takeover behavior.

options.title: Move to plugin experiment
options.body: Ask for an external plugin proof first if maintainers want to avoid adding this behavior to bundled channel runtime now.

recommendation.title: Design channel-owned takeover
recommendation.body: Define a WhatsApp-first or shared channel-plugin contract for detecting manual owner messages, storing per-thread pause state, and resuming safely with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent WhatsApp inbound/admission and auto-reply history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the channel-owned design choice.
